name: IoTwin light demo
description: Light ECU switches a lamp via CAN; wall switches in the visualizer and on the NUCLEO-G0B1RE report their position.

nodes.label: Light ECU
nodes.description: Simulated control unit, follows SWITCH_STATE and commands LAMP_CMD

nodes.label: Visualizer
nodes.description: Digital twin: relay, lamp and wall switch

nodes.label: NUCLEO-G0B1RE gateway
nodes.description: Real CAN controller (FDCAN1, internal loopback without transceiver), B1 = wall switch, LD4 = lamp

nodes.label: Host PC
nodes.description: Runs iotwin-bus, can_sim, serial_bridge and the visualizer
